clipTypes.label: Establishing location shot
clipTypes.action: Wide shot of the location with both subjects already visible in frame, no action yet — setting the scene.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subtle ambient motion in the scene. Both subjects stand naturally in place. No fighting.

clipTypes.label: Faceoff / staredown
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B stand face to face, inches apart, locked in a heated staredown. Both confident, both holding their ground. No physical contact yet. Both faces clearly visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B stare each other down, mouths moving, intense expressions. No punches.

clipTypes.label: Trash talk / yelling
clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B face to face, yelling and pointing fingers. Both confident, both holding their ground. Both faces visible.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B yell at each other, mouths moving aggressively, pointing fingers, both confident. No punches.

clipTypes.label: Subject A approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject A walks toward the location with intensity and confidence, face fully visible to camera. Subject B is not yet in frame.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A walks forward toward the camera with intensity and confidence. Camera locked.

clipTypes.label: Subject B approaches
clipTypes.action: Subject B walks toward the location with intensity and confidence, face fully visible to camera. Subject A is not yet in frame.
clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject B walks forward toward the camera with intensity and confidence. Camera locked.

clipTypes.action: Subject A and Subject B mid-fight, exchanging punches, both fighting hard, both strong. Both faces still readable.

clipTypes.label: Bystanders pull them apart

clipTypes.klingMotion: Two background figures grab Subject A and Subject B by the chest and arms, trying to pull them apart. Subject A and Subject B keep yelling and reaching for each other. No punches land.

clipTypes.klingMotion: Subject A and Subject B argue across a podcast desk, both leaning forward, mouths moving, pointing at each other across the microphones. No physical contact.
